name: Yoshino Nanana
source:
Nanana is also a student at Saint Michael's Nursing School, and she is [url=https://vndb.org/c42426]Momiji[/url]'s best friend. She went through a troublesome childhood, but she is now healthy and energetic. A nurse took good care of her when she was a child. Therefore, she wants to become a good nurse herself. As Momiji's confidante, Nanana knows just how much [url=https://vndb.org/c63887]Shinobu[/url] really means to her. Even though she sometimes likes to tease her more simple-minded friend, Nanana's too considerate and sweet to admit her own feelings for the doctor.

[Edited from [url=https://www.jastusa.com/games/im-gonna-nurse-you-voice-plus]JAST USA[/url] and [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/582494-kango-shicyauzo/faqs/36050]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
